Subject: Request for post-remediation verification and evidence (FinexCorp SOC 2)

Hi Olga,

Following the remediation window your team completed last month, FinexCorp's SOC 2 auditor has asked for a concise verification package for the penetrations identified in our November engagement. At minimum we need:

- A short verification letter from Redwood stating the findings were re-tested and closed (signed PDF).
- The delta list of fixed items (CVE/issue id, remediation date, resolution notes).
- Test metadata: testing firm name, test dates, scope (IP ranges, public endpoints, scope exclusions), and the tester point of contact.

Relevant items from our side: CVE-2026-1234 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-2029 (session fixation) were in scope; auditor wants closure evidence. Our internal ticket is JIRA SEC-AM-5278.

Can you confirm you can provide the verification letter and a redacted summary (suitable for auditors) by next week? If Acme Security needs to re-run specific checks, please call that out and propose dates.

Thanks,
Evan Torres
Security Manager, FinexCorp
security@finexcorp.com

--
